title: Read the panel
goal: Answer two questions from Telemetry: how high it is and its mode.

questions.text: How high is it above home?

steps.text: Find its height above home in Telemetry and answer.
steps.hint: Telemetry lists the height above home near the top.
The mode is at the top of the Cockpit tab, and in Telemetry.

fails.says: Failed. Three wrong answers to one question.
